i guess something happened at work. its fine. probably not even worth talking about

no its not a bad thing actually. thats the weird part. i got picked to lead this project. like the big one. my manager said my name in front of everyone

i think the hardest part is just. believing i deserve it? theres this voice that says it was luck or theyll figure out im not that good. easier to just brush it off than sit with the good part

yeah lets leave it there. thats enough for today. thanks
